source.name: Colorado Rapids: 'Colorado Rapids and UCHealth launch health-focused initiative as part of multi-year jersey rights deal'
source.quote: UCHealth’s logo will be displayed prominently on the front of all Rapids First Team match jerseys and training tops
source.note: The UCHealth jersey deal was announced 14 November 2022 and runs through the 2029 MLS season, so it covers this kit. For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor list (17 February 2026, https://www.forsoccer.com/insight/2026-mls-jersey-sponsors/) confirms UCHealth as the Rapids' front-of-jersey partner for 2026.

source.name: SportsLogos.Net: 'MLS to Allow Back-of-Jersey Ads Starting After 2026 All-Star Break'
source.quote: All 30 MLS clubs feature the Apple TV+ logo on the left sleeve patch as part of a league-wide deal.

source.name: FOR SOCCER: '2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors'
source.quote: Colorado Rapids Apple TV Media Kiewit Corporation Construction
source.note: 2026-season sleeve table: for Colorado Rapids the right sleeve shows Kiewit Corporation. The club announced Kiewit as Official Jersey Sleeve Partner on 4 July 2025, with the logo on the right sleeve of all primary and secondary jerseys (deal record colorado-rapids-kiewit-sleeve).

summary: The Colorful Colorado Kit, the Rapids' black 2026 primary with burgundy shoulders, marking 30 years as an MLS Original. UCHealth is the front-of-shirt partner through 2029; Kiewit Corporation is the right-sleeve partner; the league-wide Apple TV patch is on the left sleeve.
